rows: O Ton-di Por-ba-di-a i, Si-go-hi par-lu-hu-tan.
mar-o-lop-o-lop do-lok i, mar-ha-sak nang ga-lum-bang.
Sa-lu-hut na ti-nom-pa i, gok be las ni ro-ha-Na i, mar-su-rak Ha-le-lu-ya.

verses: O Tondi Porbadia i, Sigohi parluhutan.
marolopolop dolok i, marhasak nang galumbang.
Saluhut na tinompa i, gok be las ni rohaNa i,
marsurak Haleluya.
O Tondi Porbadia i, pabangkit panurirang,
papatar asi holongMi, tu angka na hansitan.
Sumurut do na holom i, tubu ma panghiromon i,
endehon Haleluya.
Di Tondi Porbadia i, raphon Debata Ama,
dohot Tuhanku Jesus i, Sitobus manisia.
Naung mate di hau silang i, hehe manaek tu surgo i,
endenta Haleluya.
O, Tondi Porbadia i, sigohi langit tano,
pajongjong harajaonMi, disaluhutna bangso.
Sai parrohai HuriaMi, pasangap Kristus Tuhan i,
olophon Haleluya.
title: O Tondi Porbadia i
credit: Syair: Der Geist des Hern erfult das All; Maria Luise Thurmair, 1941 · Terj.: Dcs. Bonaria Hutabarat / Pdt. Esra Pangaribuan · Lagu: Melchior Vulvius, 1609

r: O Ton-di Por-ba-di-a i, pa-bang-kit pa-nu-ri-rang,
pa-pa-tar a-si ho-long-Mi, tu ang-ka na han-si-tan.
Su-mu-rut do na ho-lom i, tu-bu ma pang-hi-ro-mon i, en-de-hon Ha-le-lu-ya.
Di Ton-di Por-ba-di-a i, rap-hon De-ba-ta A-ma,
do-hot Tu-han-ku Je-sus i, Si-to-bus ma-ni-si-a.
Naung ma-te di hau si-lang i, he-he ma-naek tu sur-go i, en-den-ta Ha-le-lu-ya.
O, Ton-di Por-ba-di-a i, si-go-hi la-ngit ta-no,
pa-jong-jong ha-ra-ja-on-Mi, di-sa-lu-hut-na bang-so.
Sai par-ro-hai Hu-ri-a-Mi, pa-sa-ngap Kris-tus Tu-han i, o-lop-hon Ha-le-lu-ya.

verses: Ro ma Ho parasiroha sai pagirgir rohangkon
mangendehon denggan basa ni lehonMu di au on,
tiruonhu ma suruan mangendehon sangapMi,
pujionhu Ho Jahowa partanobatoanki.
Na malua do tondingku, ala hagogoonMi
pos rohangku boanonMu diringkon tu surgo i
Jesus sai lului au, atik tung na lilu au
na dihophop Ho do au, na mambaen mangolu au.
Ganup ari au marutang, na so hagararan au
ndang tarasam denggan basa, na binaenMu na tu au
sai tarunjun do rohangku maninggalhon holongMi
sai sahapi ma rohangku, ngolungki di Ho mai i.

r: Na ma-lu-a do ton-ding-ku, a-la ha-go-go-on-Mi pos ro-hang-ku bo-a-non-Mu di-ring-kon tu sur-go i Je-sus sai lu-lui au, a-tik tung na li-lu au na di-hop-hop Ho do a-u, na mam-ba-en ma-ngo-lu a-u.

Ga-nup a-ri au mar-u-tang, na so ha-ga-ra-ran au ndang ta-ra-sam deng-gan ba-sa, na bi-naen-Mu na tu au sai ta-run-jun do ro-hang-ku ma-ning-gal-hon ho-long-Mi sai sa-ha-pi ma ro-hang-ku, ngo-lung-ki di Ho mai i.

rows: Sai go-hi ro-ha ton-ding-ki mar-hi-te ton-di-Mi a-sa mar-hi-te di-ring-ki pa-tar Ho Tu-han-ki.

verses: Sai gohi roha tondingki, marhite tondiMi
asa marhite diringki, patar Ho Tuhanki.
Unang holan pamanganhi, dohot ma rohangki
jala sude ma ngolungki, mamuji Ho ma i.
Sude ma pangalahongki, ro di ulaonki
nang hata nang pingkiranki, pasangap Ho ma i.
Nang saluhutna ngolungki, tongtong mamuji Ho
anggiat dohot diringkon, lao papatarhon Ho.
Nang pe gok dosa rohangkon, gale pamatangkon
alai nuaeng hupuji Ho, sai jangkon ma au on.
Antong sude ma ngolungki, parbadiai ma i
dongani au o Tuhanki, ro di ujungna i.

An-tong su-de ma ngo-lung-ki, par-ba-di-ai ma i do-nga-ni au o Tu-han-ki, ro di u-jung-na i.

rows: Be-ge ma Tu-han i, na jo-u jo-u i sai u-nang ju-a i, man-sai so-nang do i, be-ta hi-ta lao ma-ngu-la tu la-dang ni Tu-han i Di jou Tu-han-ta ho tu go-ti-lon i pe-le-hon ma ngo-lu-mi ma-ngo-lo-i Tu-han i lao ma-ngu-la di Ha-ra-jaon-Na i.

verses: Bege ma Tuhan i, na jou-jou i
sai unang jua i, mansai sonang do i,
beta hita lao mangula tu ladang ni Tuhan i
Di jou Tuhanta ho tu gotilon i
pelehon ma ngolumi mangoloi Tuhan
i lao mangula di HarajaonNa i.
Oloi ma Tuhan i mangsai uli di i,
porsan ma silangmi, mansai sonang do i,
bela hita lao mangula tu ladang ni Tuhan i,
di jou Tuhanta ho tu gotilon i,
pelehon ma ngolumi mangoloi Tuhanta i.
lao mangula di HarajaonNa i.
